story: Rosa and Ali are at the park. They want to eat lunch and enjoy the nice day. Ali gives Rosa a bowl of salad. They both sit inside a small tent to eat. After lunch, they walk to the library to practise French.
title: A Great Lunch
setting: A sunny green park with a small tent and a library nearby.

characters.name: Rosa
characters.look: A girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress.

characters.name: Ali
characters.look: A boy with short black hair and a blue shirt.

sentences.en: The weather is very good today.
sentences.scene_prompt: A bright sunny day in a green park with a blue sky.

sentences.en: Rosa and Ali are out in the park.
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa with long brown hair and Ali with short black hair walking in a park.

sentences.en: Ali wears a clean blue shirt.
sentences.zh: Ali穿着一件干净的蓝色衬衫。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali with short black hair wearing a blue shirt.

sentences.en: Ali gives Rosa a big salad.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali handing a bowl of green salad to Rosa.

sentences.en: They both sit inside a small tent.
sentences.zh: 他们两个人都坐在一个小帐篷里面。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa and Ali sitting together inside a small blue tent.

sentences.en: The salad is great and fresh.
sentences.zh: 这道沙拉很棒而且很新鲜。
sentences.scene_prompt: A close up of a bowl of salad inside a tent.

sentences.en: They do not miss their lunch.
sentences.zh: 他们没有错过他们的午餐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa and Ali eating happily in the park.

sentences.en: Ali sits behind Rosa twice today.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali sitting on the grass behind Rosa.

sentences.en: They follow the path to the library.
sentences.zh: 他们沿着小路走向图书馆。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa and Ali walking along a path towards a library building.

sentences.en: They practise French at the library.
sentences.zh: 他们在图书馆练习法语。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa and Ali sitting at a table inside a library with books.
